15                THE SECRETARY:   Legislative 

16   resolution by Senator Griffo, honoring Chazz 

17   Palminteri for his commitment to preserving 

18   Italian-American heritage.

19                "WHEREAS, It is the sense of this 

20   Legislative Body to pay tribute to those 

21   individuals of true purpose and worthy 

22   accomplishment that provide opportunities to 

23   celebrate their rich ethnic flavor and which 

24   strive to preserve their cultural heritage; and 

25                "WHEREAS, Attendant to such concern, 

                                                                3708

 1   and in full accord with its long-standing 

 2   traditions, this Legislative Body is justly proud 

 3   to honor Chazz Palminteri for his commitment to 

 4   preserving Italian-American heritage, to be 

 5   observed at the Italian-American Day celebration 

 6   in Albany, New York, on Monday, June 6, 2011; and 

 7                "WHEREAS, Born on May 15, 1952, in 

 8   the Bronx, New York, Calogero Lorenzo Palminteri 

 9   known as Chazz, grew up in a rough neighborhood 

10   which taught him vital life lessons that would 

11   later prove very useful in pursuing his passion 

12   and lifework; and 

13                "WHEREAS, After graduating from 

14   Theodore Roosevelt High School, Chazz Palminteri 

15   went on to foster his craft of writing, acting 

16   and directing, and in 1973, studied with Lee 

17   Strasberg at the Actors Studio; and 

18                "WHEREAS, Due to the negative 

19   stereotypes of the wise guys and hoodlums of the 

20   Italian-American community, Chazz Palminteri, 

21   through his dedication and hard work, has 

22   attempted to shed light on the accomplishments of 

23   his true hero, the working man, the glue that 

24   holds together all the Italian-American 

25   communities throughout the country; and 

                                                                3709

 1                "WHEREAS, Chazz Palminteri has been 

 2   a natural choice to continue the Italianate torch 

 3   in film, bringing true grit, muscle, and an 

 4   evocative realism to the sidewalks of his 

 5   New York neighborhood; and 

 6                "WHEREAS, Well known for 'A Bronx 

 7   Tale,' Chazz Palminteri originally wrote the 

 8   semi-autobiographical script for the stage, and 

 9   in 1988 performed the masterpiece as a one-man 

10   show in Los Angeles, in which he played 18 

11   different roles, before moving the production to 

12   New York.  This outstanding performance earned 

13   him nominations for the New York Outer Critics 

14   Circle for both acting and writing; and 

15                "WHEREAS, While in New York, Chazz 

16   Palminteri completed the screenplay of 'A Bronx 

17   Tale' and in 1993 found himself starring opposite 

18   Robert DeNiro in the film, who chose the script 

19   for his directorial debut; and 

20                "WHEREAS, Extremely talented and 

21   multifaceted, Chazz Palminteri has given 

22   acclaimed performances in film, television, and 

23   on stage, portraying both dramatic and comedic 

24   roles.  He has also voiced characters in various 

25   animated films, and has written as well as 

                                                                3710

 1   directed, while always remaining true to his 

 2   proud Italian-American heritage; and 

 3                "WHEREAS, The recipient of numerous 

 4   awards and accolades, Chazz Palminteri received 

 5   the 1996 Leadership in Entertainment Award from 

 6   the Coalition of Italo-American Associations, 

 7   Inc., and was honored by President Clinton with a 

 8   Special Achievement Award for the Performing Arts 

 9   from the National Italian-American Foundation in 

10   Washington, D.C.; and 

11                "WHEREAS, Chazz Palminteri earned 

12   high praise and an Academy Award nomination for 

13   his performance in 'Bullets Over Broadway,' in 

14   which he portrayed a gangster with unexpected 

15   dramaturgical gifts.  This earned him an 

16   Independent Spirit Award for Best Supporting 

17   Actor, as well as nominations for a Screen Actors 

18   Guild Award and an American Comedy Award; and 

19                "WHEREAS, In addition, Chazz 

20   Palminteri is the national spokesperson for the 

21   Cooley's Anemia Foundation, leading the fight in 

22   finding a cure for thalassemia; and 

23                "WHEREAS, With him throughout have 

24   been his wife, Gianna, and their two children, 

25   Dante Lorenzo and Gabriella Rose, all of whom 

                                                                3711

 1   feel privileged to be part of his life and 

 2   rejoice in his achievements; and 

 3                "WHEREAS, It is the sense of this 

 4   Legislative Body, in keeping with its 

 5   time-honored traditions, to recognize and pay 

 6   tribute to those individuals who foster ethnic 

 7   pride and enhance the profile of cultural 

 8   diversity which strengthens the fabric of the 

 9   communities of New York State; now, therefore, be 

10   it 

11                "RESOLVED, That this Legislative 

12   Body pause in its deliberations to honor Chazz 

13   Palminteri for his commitment to preserving 

14   Italian-American heritage; and be it further 

15                "RESOLVED, That copies of this 

16   resolution, suitably engrossed, be transmitted to 

17   Chazz Palminteri."

22                We are indeed honored to have to

25   Sicily, and he was born in the Bronx.  He's a

 1   great American success story, as you heard in the 

 2   resolution talking about what he has accomplished 

 3   in his life.  

 4                He is a truly remarkable

 8   renowned actor and recognized accordingly, but 

 9   also what he's done in ways that he's contributed 

10   back to his community -- to the City of New York, 

11   to the State of New York, and also to the 

12   Italian-American community, which I know many 

13   Italian-Americans are very proud.  

14                As you heard, he got a big break 

15   when Robert DeNiro recognized some great talent 

16   and saw him off-Broadway.  And as a result, when 

17   they saw him performing "A Bronx Tale," this was 

18   when Robert DeNiro made him an offer with a 

19   handshake, I think.  And that is truly remarkable 

20   and says a lot about the individuals that we're 

21   talking about here, both Robert DeNiro and Chazz 

22   Palminteri.  

23                He's had an enormously successful 

24   career that's spanned every landmark and 

25   achievement.  He's appeared off-Broadway, on 

                                                                3713

 1   Broadway, television, movies.  He has really 

 2   covered all genres and really appealed to so many 

 3   people, including comedy as well as drama.  

 4                And there are times, Chazz, when 

 5   people may look at the Capitol and wonder whether 

 6   or not we can do a story about Albany and the 

 7   State of New York too.  So maybe someday if you 

 8   get into directing you may want to consider that.

 9                But this is a really remarkable 

10   career.  And as I said, I'm so pleased that he 

11   was able to join us tonight.  He will be 

12   recognized at the Festa Italiana tonight as well 

13   as in the Assembly Chamber later.  

14                And I think his life and career 

15   epitomize the American dream -- with hard work 

16   and talent, you can achieve great success.  

17                And I want to thank you for honoring 

18   us with your presence here today, Chazz, and 

19   those who are with you.  I want to congratulate 

20   you and your beautiful wife, Gianna, and your 

21   children.  Twenty years of marriage, God bless 

22   you -- many more.  

23                So I present to the body today Chazz 

24   Palminteri, and thank you for being with us.
